dataset.name: Pedrotti et al. 2023 EyeLink 1000 raw reading data

source_files.source_bytes_policy: download published bytes unchanged; verify every expected MD5 before preprocessing; compute SHA256 source manifest in GazeAudit

task.numeric_classifier: strip only ASCII whitespace plus comma, period, apostrophe, right single quotation mark, non-breaking space, and narrow no-break space; remaining text must be ASCII digits only
task.separator_policy: collapse with-separator and without-separator numeral variants within length condition
task.other_stimuli: words, pseudowords, and any stimulus not matching the frozen numeric classifier are outside the estimand

dataset.exclusions: none; fail closed if a participant lacks at least one analyzable short and one analyzable long numeric trial

representation.name: published dominant-eye raw sample stream
representation.participant_identity: zero-padded filename stem; embedded source fields must not replace filename identity
representation.trial_identity: TRIAL_INDEX, with one stable TrialTextShown value required within each trial
representation.eye_selection: for each participant use the single eye side with finite published gaze; never average or combine left and right; fail closed if both sides contain finite gaze or neither side does
representation.time_order: TIMESTAMP must be finite and strictly increasing within each participant-by-trial stream
representation.native_missingness: preserve published missing gaze as non-finite coordinates; no interpolation, carry-forward, nearest-finite substitution, or row deletion before perturbation

endpoint.name: participant-balanced long-minus-short numeric gaze-path-length rate
endpoint.trial_numerator: sum Euclidean pixel displacement between consecutive scheduled samples only when both endpoints have finite x and y; a non-finite scheduled sample breaks the path and is never bridged
endpoint.trial_denominator: unperturbed source trial duration in seconds from first to last published TIMESTAMP; the same denominator is reused for every perturbation
endpoint.trial_estimate: trial_numerator / trial_denominator, in pixels per second; zero or non-finite source duration fails closed
endpoint.condition_estimate: unweighted mean trial estimate within short-numeric or long-numeric condition for each participant
endpoint.estimand_scope: descriptive fixed-cohort contrast used to audit sensitivity to sampling and missingness; no population p-value or causal claim

sampling.name: controlled sampling-rate perturbation
sampling.method: within each trial retain existing source rows nearest to a regular grid anchored at the first source timestamp; ties resolve to the earlier source row
sampling.native_missingness_order: downsample the full source timeline while preserving native non-finite gaze; do not remove missing rows before scheduled-row selection
sampling.baseline_policy: 1000-Hz baseline is the unmodified published row timeline, not a resampled copy
sampling.family: sampling-only; no added missingness is injected in sampling perturbations

missingness.name: controlled additional gaze-loss perturbation
missingness.fraction_denominator: number of source rows with finite x and y within the participant trial before added masking
missingness.mcar_within_trial: mask exactly round(fraction * finite_rows) finite gaze rows sampled uniformly without replacement within each trial
missingness.single_block_within_trial: choose a source-row start uniformly among starts from which the target number of finite samples remains, then mask the shortest forward contiguous source-time window containing exactly round(fraction * finite_rows) finite samples; native missing rows inside the window remain missing and do not count toward the added target
missingness.seed_derivation: derive each participant x trial x mechanism x fraction x replicate child seed from SHA256 of the frozen root seed and lexical specification key, making results invariant to loop order or parallel execution
missingness.native_missingness_policy: native missingness is preserved and is never counted as newly injected missingness
missingness.coordinate_policy: mask x and y together; timestamps, trial labels, row order, and source duration remain unchanged
missingness.family: missingness-only at the native 1000-Hz representation; no downsampling is combined with added missingness

interpretation.name: predeclared perturbation recovery classification
interpretation.per_estimate_recovery: finite perturbed estimate has the same strict sign as a nonzero reference and absolute relative deviation |perturbed-reference|/|reference| <= relative_tolerance
interpretation.reference_zero_policy: if the reference study estimate is exactly zero, overall classification is indeterminate_reference_zero; do not introduce an outcome-responsive scale or tolerance
interpretation.sampling_family_recovery: fraction of the five predeclared lower-rate estimates satisfying per-estimate recovery
interpretation.missingness_family_recovery: for each mechanism x fraction cell, fraction of its 20 predeclared replicates satisfying per-estimate recovery
interpretation.robust: every sampling and missingness family recovery is at least minimum_family_recovery
interpretation.materially_fragile: at least one sampling or missingness family recovery is at most material_fragility_ceiling
interpretation.incomplete: any source identity, cohort, condition, trial-duration, perturbation, or endpoint validation required by this protocol fails
interpretation.population_inference: none; perturbation recovery fractions are sensitivity diagnostics, not confidence intervals, posterior probabilities, or p-values
interpretation.post_outcome_rule: after the first archived result is revealed, no cohort, endpoint, perturbation grid, mechanism, replicate count, seed, tolerance, recovery threshold, or classification rule may be changed in response to the outcome
